notes: Visible field backpacks are standard gear, with an I-key inventory linked directly to finite town goods and personal pockets. Trading pairs your backpack with merchant stock in opaque animated tile grids, with quantity and Buy/Sell controls always visible. Shared actions and vehicle confirmations use separate network channels from bulk town updates; queued views stay bounded and ping appears beside FPS. Residents have physical collisions, separated work positions, realistic walking and job-specific work poses. Player anatomy, collision height and eye level measure six feet (1.8288 m). Install the full 0.7.1 package for multiplayer protocol 14; bootstrap 3 is retained. Existing local saves and server town ownership are preserved.
